messages:
Morgan L: quick handoff — I'm stepping off in 10m. Ongoing alert: P1 embeddings p99 latency from eu-west cluster. Impact: downstream search/recall customers seeing slow embedding responses and some timeouts. Root cause suspect: KV cache churn after a bad rollout earlier today. :rotating_light:
OpsBot: Pager triggered: P1 | embeddings-p99-eu-west | metric: embeddings.p99_latency > 1200ms | alert_id: AB12C | pages: @oncall_primary
Priya S: saw sustained eviction spikes on the primary cache nodes, memory pressure from a new QA job that slipped into prod. I've already paused that job and backfilled a larger cache allocation on the node group. Evictions dropped ~40% but p99 still elevated.
Alex H: thanks. Status so far: throttling enabled on best-effort endpoints to protect core generation, prefetch disabled for embeddings for affected shards, increased the per-worker soft limit. No customer-facing rate limits yet — only internal shedding.
Jamal R: I rolled a restart of the embeddings-worker pool on eu-west-2a to clear stuck KV handles. Command used: ```bash
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/embeddings-worker-eu-west-2a
``` Logs after restart (last 5 lines):
```
INFO  EmbeddingWorker starting shard=7
WARN  KVCache miss_ratio=0.62
INFO  Prefetch disabled=true
ERROR EvictionWarning keys_removed=1245
INFO  Health=degraded->recovering
```
Alex H: good, thank you. Remaining actions: 1) monitor p99 for 10m window; 2) if p99 > 900ms for two consecutive 5m buckets, promote fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for embeddings for affected customer cohorts; 3) open follow-up to revert the QA job change and add isolation. Runbook ref: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p99>.
Priya S: note on fallback: when we swap model variant we must also adjust latency-based routing in the console to avoid cold-starting extra pools. I can pre-warm the quantized variant in eu-west-standby.
OpsBot: DeployBot reported: rollout "qa-batch-job/v2" detected in prod at ~08:12 UTC — action: paused by Priya S.
Alex H: coverage — I'm taking primary for the next 2h; Priya S will be secondary for escalation. @Jamal R please keep monitoring the worker restarts and embed queue length — you were on the restart earlier so you have context.
Jamal R: watching queues and the KV eviction metrics. Current queue length is 42 (target < 100). Seeing occasional spikes to ~180 for short bursts; correlating with a customer replay at 07:58 UTC.
Morgan L: thanks team — leaving these notes in thread. Key follow-ups for next shift: add a guardrail to prevent QA batch jobs from being scheduled on production cache nodes; add an alert for eviction-rate > 500/min; run an after-action to tighten preflight checks for scheduled jobs.
Alex H: handover summary (primary=Alex H, secondary=Priya S, in-flight mitigations: cache allocation increase, paused QA job, embeddings-worker restart, prefetch disabled, throttling enabled on best-effort routes). Customer impact: degraded latency for some customers, no broad data loss, partial 504s observed at p99 for a small cohort. Next milestones: confirm p99 < 700ms in 30m, if not cutover to quantized variant. Follow-ups filed: ENG-OPS-1287 (QA job isolation), ENG-OPS-1288 (eviction-alert), ENG-OPS-1289 (routing prewarm). :thumbsup:
Priya S: added watchers and will pre-warm quantized pools if p99 doesn't drop after the observation window.
Alex H: I'm going to leave a quick checklist in the incident board and tag support to message affected customers if we exceed the SLA window. I'll update this thread before I go offline.
